scientific_question: Can the source-recorded objective PRE S count add stable conditional second/third-place information while leaving the S0 winner model exactly untouched?

feature_definition.source: KDreams PRE rider table 直近4ヶ月の成績

baseline.name: S0_SCORE_ONLY_STANDARD_PL
baseline.stage2_logits: beta * competition_score after actual stage1 winner removal
baseline.stage3_logits: beta * competition_score after actual stage1 and stage2 finisher removal

candidate.name: S0_OBJECTIVE_S_COUNT_CONDITIONAL_PL_V1
candidate.stage2_logits: beta * competition_score + gamma * S after actual stage1 winner removal
candidate.stage3_logits: beta * competition_score + gamma * S after actual stage1 and stage2 finisher removal

fit_objective.equivalence_note: Because stage1 is invariant to gamma, optimization is equivalent to minimizing mean L2+L3 on the fit set.

data_split.reason: Strictly after the 2026-07-17 B-count evaluation date and therefore temporally beyond the explicitly burned Tactical/B-count populations.

fit_set.selection: whole accessible meeting/day blocks in chronological KDreams daily-listing source order
fit_set.stop_rule: Do not stop within a meeting block. Close at the end of the first locked block where cumulative successful races >= 50.

evaluation_holdout.selection: whole accessible meeting/day blocks in chronological KDreams daily-listing source order
evaluation_holdout.stop_rule: Do not stop within a meeting block. Close at the end of the first locked block where cumulative successful races >= 50.

winner_invariance: winner_log_loss exactly unchanged within numerical tolerance
winner_brier exactly unchanged within numerical tolerance
winner probabilities max absolute difference equals zero within numerical tolerance

conditions: 95pct race-cluster bootstrap CI upper bound for candidate-minus-S0 ordered_top3_log_loss < 0
